name: Grok Imagine 2.0
description: xAI's image model. Instruction edit of the crop plus the reference layers, no mask input: the stitch keeps the selection. Model id from fal's model index on 2026-09-11; the adapter is written from the provider's schema and has not run against the live API yet.

fal.note: At most three images go in (crop plus two references). The output size is Resolution, not the crop; aspect_ratio stays auto, which keeps the crop's shape. For area-directed edits set Fill to green and Original on, and say "fill the green area".
